subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “There is no computer and no library card.”?
options: Some parents write to their children.
Children write their names and book titles in a notebook.
He used many dates and names, and the children forgot them quickly.
They did not have to write their names.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Some parents write to their children.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「There is no computer and no library card. Children write their names and book titles in a notebook.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「He used many dates and names, and the children forgot them quickly.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「They did not have to write their names.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「There is no computer and no library card. Children write their names and book titles in a notebook.」，答案為「Children write their names and book titles in a notebook.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Children write their names and book titles in a notebook.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
